name: io.github.agentwares/seatledger
description: Local ledger of Claude Code and Codex tokens, API-equivalent cost, limits and token-rate changes.
title: seatledger

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Claude Code's config directory, if not ~/.claude; transcripts are read from its projects/ folder

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Codex's home directory, if not ~/.codex; rollouts are read from its sessions/ folder

environmentVariables.name: SEATLEDGER_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Where seatledger keeps your limits and its cache of counts (default ~/.seatledger)

environmentVariables.name: SEATLEDGER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Team ledger push key for seatledger_team_summary, if not saved by `seatledger team join`
